title: Sweet Blackberry Crumble
description: A delicious dessert featuring a sweet blackberry filling topped with a crunchy oat and aromatic spice crumble. Perfect for warm weather.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, mix together the blackberries and brown sugar. Let it sit for about 15 minutes, until the blackberries start to release their juice.
3. In a separate bowl, mix together the oats, aromatic spice, and skillet. Add the milk and eggs, and mix until a crumbly mixture forms.
4. Pour the blackberry mixture into a 9x9-inch baking dish. Top with the crumble mixture, spreading it evenly.
5. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
6. Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
